      "section": "tome-orcs/overload/data/texts/unlock-tinker_annihilator.lua",
      "source": "After researching the remains of many foes you found new ways to bring the literal heat of battle to your foes!\nYou can now create new characters with the #LIGHT_GREEN#Annihilator class#WHITE#.\n\nAnnihilators are Tinkers that can create and use heavy weapons (flamethrowers, shockstaves, boltguns) and apply their tinkering knowledge to create advanced war contraptions.\nClass features:#YELLOW#\n- Unleash the power of your heavy weapons\n- Construct automated turrets for war or even medical purposes\n- Build an mecharachnid bot to help you in combat that can act independently or be directly piloted\n- Make your foes suffer in many new ways: fire rockets and grenades at them, equip an exoskeleton, ... #WHITE#\n\nAll Tinker classes use Steam for their powers.\n",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "研究过众多敌人的残骸后，你找到了把真正的“战斗之火”带给敌人的新方法！\n现在可以创建#LIGHT_GREEN#歼灭者#WHITE#职业的新角色。\n\n歼灭者是能够制造和使用重装武器（火焰喷射器、电击棒和爆矢枪）的工匠，还能运用工艺知识创造先进的战争装置。\n职业特色：#YELLOW#\n- 释放重装武器的威力\n- 建造用于战斗甚至医疗的自动炮台\n- 制造机械蜘蛛机器人协助战斗；它既可自主行动，也可由你直接驾驶\n- 用种种新手段折磨敌人：向他们发射火箭和手榴弹、装备外骨骼……#WHITE#\n\n所有工匠职业都以蒸汽驱动能力。\n"
    },
    {

      "notes": "Lite review batch 0235 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "tome-orcs/overload/mod/class/OrcCampaign.lua",
      "source": "Please help me! I am afraid I lost myself in this place while testing some new steamtech. I know there is a recall portal left around here by a friend, but I have fought too many battles, and I fear I will not make it. Would you help me?",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "帮帮我！我在测试一种新的蒸汽科技时，在这地方迷路了。我有个朋友在这附近给我留下了一个召回传送门，不过我打了太多仗，恐怕靠我自己是到不了那里了，你能帮我一下吗？"
